statement: At the pinned SDL revision, the Xbox One HIDAPI backend uses a shared Xbox One-type driver for both generations but sets Share support via SDL_IsJoystickXboxSeriesX. SDL's core older-controller exclusion table includes Microsoft USB 0x02d1, 0x02dd, 0x02ea and Bluetooth 0x02fd and 0x0b20, so the HIDAPI driver advertises eleven buttons rather than the Series twelve-button layout for these identities. The helper's default for unlisted IDs is not proof that unfamiliar hardware has Share.

applicability.revision: Microsoft original Xbox One and One S known older IDs at pinned SDL revision; other vendor IDs are not generalized
applicability.scope: SDL_joystick.c:127-148,3382-3406; SDL_hidapi_xboxone.c:180-183,364-394,461-468,496-520. SDL classification and button count, not physical button existence.
